decision: Preserve NFDB v1 labels. Province point/area key and date/cell disagreements require separately versioned label adjudication. Do not concatenate or automatically overwrite.
normalization_note: Start/out timestamps normalized to UTC recorded calendar date only; no ignition clock time inferred. Source records and duplicate keys preserved.
join_note: All 8,109 retained NFDB rows have >=1 exact (year, stripped uppercase fire identifier) provincial point candidate; 8,105 distinct NFDB IDs. Join expands to 8,131 rows because keys repeat. Candidate rows are not confirmed one-to-one matches.
strict_rule: Exact normalized identifier + year + recorded start date + 10 km cell. One candidate required. Disagreements quarantined; existing labels preserved.
